taxonomy_note: Analyst planning lens; reassess actual root cause.

controls.boundary: Credentials and sensitive secret exposure — authoritative consumer
controls.source_trace: Establish secret type/owner, source/build/log location, intended audience, reachable recipient and rotation/revocation state using nonsecret metadata. Do not print or test real values against services.
controls.controlled_verification: Trace a supplied candidate through artifact distribution and consumer trust. Distinguish a public client identifier, test fixture and real credential using issuer/owner documentation or approved offline context. Record only redacted bytes/fingerprint and who can access the exposure.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Entropy or a key-like prefix is a lead, not proof of a valid credential. A real secret in a properly protected owner vault is not unintended exposure; a stale credential may still require cleanup without current compromise claims.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Remove the exposure path and have the owner rotate/revoke according to the actual credential lifecycle; deleting a current file does not erase previous distributed artifacts. Retest with a synthetic marker and owner-confirmed lifecycle state.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
